title: Exploration Journal
description: Explore the world, keep a journal of discoveries, and level it up — all in one Minecraft plugin.
body:
Exploration Journal

Exploration Journal is an advanced Minecraft server plugin that turns world exploration into an exciting adventure. Players can record discovered biomes, found structures, and unique discoveries, level up their journal, and unlock new features along the way.

[![Support Exploration Journal on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support%20ExplorationJournal-Ko--fi-29C7FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white&labelColor=101826)](https://ko-fi.com/erotoro)

✨ Main Features

🧭 Journal Tier System (I–IV): Unlock new features as you progress.

🏰 Structure Exploration: The plugin tracks time spent inside a structure before it counts as discovered.

🌍 BlueMap Integration: Display player discoveries on your server’s 3D map.

💬 DiscordSRV: Log major discoveries directly to your Discord channel.

📜 Book Export: Create a physical in-game book containing a list of all your achievements.

📊 PlaceholderAPI: Show player stats in scoreboards or menus.

🚀 Folia Support: Full compatibility with multithreaded server cores.

🛠 Journal Crafting

Journals are crafted in a crafting table. Each next tier requires the previous one.

🎮 Commands and Permissions
Player Commands (/journal or /ej)
Command	Description	Required Tier	Permission
/journal	Open the journal (book interface)	I	explorationjournal.use
/journal biomes	List discovered biomes	I	explorationjournal.use
/journal structures	List discovered structures	I	explorationjournal.use
/journal discoveries	List unique discoveries	I	explorationjournal.use
/journal stats [player]	View statistics	I	explorationjournal.use
/journal map	View coordinates of your discovered biomes	II	explorationjournal.use
/journal export	Create a report book	III	explorationjournal.export
/journal top [cat]	Top players (biomes / structures / disc)	IV	explorationjournal.top
/journal give <player>	Give a copy of your journal	I	explorationjournal.give
Admin Commands (/journaladmin or /eja)

All admin commands require the permission explorationjournal.admin.

/journaladmin reset <player> — Fully reset a player’s data.

/journaladmin give <player> <1-4> — Give a journal of a specific tier.

/journaladmin reload — Reload the plugin configuration files.

🧩 Integrations
PlaceholderAPI

%explorationjournal_level% — Player journal tier

%explorationjournal_biomes_found% — Number of discovered biomes

%explorationjournal_structures_found% — Number of discovered structures

BlueMap

Automatically creates markers at locations where players make unique discoveries.

DiscordSRV

Sends messages to a configured Discord channel when a biome or structure is discovered for the first time on the server.
